nodes.label: N
nodes.description: N denotes the system size involved in the analysis, indicating the number of spins present in the network.<SEP>N represents the number of spins considered in the XY model system, specifically denoted as $N=64$ in the provided context.

nodes.label: $\mathbb{J}^R_{\rm inf}$
nodes.description: The $\mathbb{J}^R_{\rm inf}$ refers to the inferred couplings in the analysis, which reproduces the expected step function.

nodes.label: $\mathbb{J}^R_{\rm tru}$
nodes.description: The $\mathbb{J}^R_{\rm tru}$ represents the true couplings in the system that are used for comparison against the inferred couplings.

nodes.label: Gibbs-Boltzmann Distribution
nodes.description: The Gibbs-Boltzmann distribution is a probability distribution of the states of a system in thermodynamic equilibrium at a given temperature, describing how the probabilities of various states depend on energy.

nodes.label: Intensities
nodes.description: Intensities refer to quantities that can be considered constants in certain equations and are discussed in the context of the XY model and Hamiltonian functions.

nodes.label: Data Configurations
nodes.description: Data configurations refer to specific arrangements of variables that are used in the context of inferring couplings in the Hamiltonian.

nodes.label: Matrix J
nodes.description: Matrix J is described as the whole interaction matrix used to represent the relationships among electromagnetic modes and their phases.

nodes.label: Phase-Only Spatial Light Modulator
nodes.description: The phase-only spatial light modulator (SLM) is a device that produces homogeneous illumination in the context of the input intensities in electromagnetic configurations.

nodes.label: E^{\rm in}_k
nodes.description: E^{\rm in}_k indicates the input intensities produced by a phase-only spatial light modulator, representing the initial values in the configuration.

nodes.label: Quenched Intensities
nodes.description: Quenched intensities refer to situations where the intensity of each mode remains constant for every solution at fixed input conditions.

nodes.label: Temperature Behavior
nodes.description: Temperature Behavior investigates how reconstruction error varies with temperature during the application of inference techniques.
